user.title: Configure Smart Fuel Price
user.description: Choose a fuel price data provider. The next step will ask for the details that provider needs (a city, or GasBuddy station IDs).

data.station_ids: Station ID(s), comma-separated. Find one at gasbuddy.com/gaspricemap -> click a station -> the number at the end of the URL (gasbuddy.com/station/<id>).

error.unsupported_city: The specified city is not supported by the selected provider.
error.station_ids_required: Enter at least one GasBuddy station ID.
error.fuel_grade_required: Select at least one fuel grade.
error.invalid_station_id: One or more station IDs could not be validated against GasBuddy -- double check them.
error.unsupported_fuel_grade: These fuel grade(s) are not offered by the station(s): {grades}.

abort.already_configured: This provider/city (or station selection) is already configured.

init.title: Attributes & Caching
init.description: Select the attributes you want to DISABLE. Checked attributes will NOT be written to the Home Assistant database. The cache threshold controls how long fetched data is reused before the integration hits the network again.
